evidence.snippet: To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,846 QA pairs designed to evaluate the end-to-end retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline over realistic data lakes.

claire_radar.motivation: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: This benchmark fills the gap in evaluating QA systems on heterogeneous, weakly structured data lakes, exposing failure modes where high-quality retrieval does not guarantee correct reasoning, which is crucial for agentic QA development.
